_doc: OPS-WORKTREE-WORK-PENDING-W1 CH1 — the classification manifest consumed by scripts/lib/worktree-work-pending.sh. It answers ONE question: which dirty paths are NOISE (class B) rather than WORK (class A). Anything a row does not match is class A, because the fail-safe direction is to treat an unrecognised path as somebody's unsaved work.
_match_semantics: `basename` compares the FINAL path component EXACTLY. This is deliberately NOT gitignore semantics — no trailing-slash form, no directory-only rule — because reusing those would reintroduce, one layer up, the exact defect this wave exists to retire: `.gitignore`'s `node_modules/` matches directories only, and git stores a worktree's node_modules as a SYMLINK, so it never matched. `relpath` compares the whole worktree-relative path exactly. `glob` matches the whole relative path as a shell pattern.
_reason_policy: Every row carries its `reason` ON THE ROW, never in prose — an exemption that lives only in a comment gets 'fixed' by a future wave enforcing the contract. No row carries a measured BYTE FIGURE: a reason records the load-bearing PROPERTY (reproducible / regenerable / must-never-be-committed), and a number with no instrument beside it is exactly what this estate has twice had to retract.
_repos_scope: The 3 repos this wave declares. `cc-session.sh clean` sweeps every primary on the machine (27 discovered on 2026-08-20), so the scope is DECLARED here rather than inferred, and any corroboration against that tool must be restricted to this set or the two instruments are not comparable.

_repos_out_of_scope.reason: has worktrees but is outside this wave's declared 3-repo scope; no classification rows have been derived for it. Adopting it is a deliberate act, not a default.
has a worktree root but is outside this wave's declared 3-repo scope; same reasoning as algovault-skills.

rows.reason: untracked ONLY because .gitignore's `node_modules/` carries a trailing slash, which per gitignore(5) matches directories only, and a worktree's entry is a SYMLINK (git stores it as a blob, mode 120000) — never work; reinstallable with `npm ci`
regenerable via `uv lock`; recorded here because it is the real untracked payload behind exempt_paths rows that claimed to protect a `data/` directory which does not exist in those worktrees
reproducible environment, rebuilt from the lockfile; classifies B whether it is a directory or a symlink, because the matcher compares the final path component and has no directory semantics
reproducible type-check cache; its size was once mis-recorded as research `data/` in two exempt_paths rows, which is why it is named explicitly rather than left to fall through to class A

local-only operator runbook mandated at this exact path by the `napkin` skill; deliberately gitignored in crypto-quant-signal-mcp and MUST NEVER be committed — it names filesystem layout and the production container. Measured 2026-08-20: it is untracked and NOT ignored in autonomous-optimizer, so without this row it classifies A and a preserve step would sweep it into a WIP tree

_promotion_note: CH1 deliberately shipped NO `promotion` key; CH4 adds it here, which is the only key CH4 may write in this file. Field names reconcile the spec with the estate's canonical shape: the spec calls the time bound `not_before`, `assertPromotionBound` calls it `escalate_after`. ONE field is carried, not both — a date duplicated at two names is a fact that goes stale at one of them.

promotion.reason: REPORT-first with BOTH conditions, because a numeric criterion with no deadline is how a report-only guard becomes permanent, and a deadline with no criterion promotes a guard that has not earned it. Flip to blocking only when 30+ recorded session-end observations show max_class_a_stranded = 0 AND the date has passed. The criterion is a MAX rather than a count or a ratio, which is what makes it ungameable from the inside: extra observations cannot lower a maximum, so a deliberate run can only raise it truthfully or leave it alone.

instrument.population: class_a_count observed at session end, one row per fired SessionEnd hook, appended as OBS lines to $GIT_COMMON_DIR/algovault-work-pending.log
instrument.reason: Grade D, the same shape as gate-staleness: the hook writes the log, and the value is world-state at an instant that is NOT recomputable later — re-running the predicate tomorrow measures tomorrow. But a deliberate invocation cannot MANUFACTURE a violation. The criterion is a maximum over observations, so firing the hook in a clean worktree adds a TRUE sample that cannot lower the max, and firing it in a dirty one raises the max truthfully and DELAYS promotion. There is no invocation that fabricates progress toward the flip. Not grade B: the log is not a cache of anything re-derivable, which is why `rederive` is deliberately absent. Deliberately NOT recorded in this tracked config — a run counter in the file the subject edits would make the hook a generator of the very dirt it reports on, and an instrument the subject can rewrite is grade C.
